headline: 19 million users: Pathao data breach claim as hackers demand $400k
summary: Hackers claim to have stolen 133GB of sensitive user data, including NIDs and addresses, demanding a ransom from the digital platform.
details: A hacker group claims to have accessed the data of approximately 19 million Pathao users. The stolen information reportedly includes phone numbers, emails, NID numbers, driving licenses, locations, Facebook profiles, and home addresses.
caption:
19 million users' data leaked? Hackers are demanding $400,000 from Pathao to keep it private.

A hacker group claims to have accessed the data of approximately 19 million Pathao users. The stolen information reportedly includes phone numbers, emails, NID numbers, driving licenses, locations, Facebook profiles, and home addresses.

headline_marked: Bangladesh signs [[15-year deal with DP World]] to operate NCT
headline: Bangladesh signs 15-year deal with DP World to operate NCT
summary: The agreement covers the operation and maintenance of the New Container Terminal (NCT) and its overflow yard, aiming to boost port efficiency and logistics infrastructure.
details: Bangladesh has signed a 15-year concession agreement with DP World to operate the New Container Terminal (NCT) and its overflow container yard in Chattogram.
The deal aims to modernize the terminal, increase operational efficiency, and enhance the overall capacity of the country's port and logistics infrastructure.
The agreement was discussed during a meeting between the Prime Minister and a delegation led by DP World's Chairman of the Board of Directors, Essa Kazim, at the secretariat on Thursday evening.
During the meeting, they also discussed expanding trade and investment between Bangladesh and the United Arab Emirates, as well as developments in the logistics sector.
The deal has faced opposition from some leftist groups and port labour organizations, who have announced mass hunger strikes to protest the agreement.
Police have already intervened to disperse protesters who erupted over the DP World deal to operate the NCT.
caption:
A 15-year deal has been signed for DP World to operate the New Container Terminal. But the agreement is coming amid intense protests and police action.

Bangladesh has signed a 15-year concession agreement with DP World to operate the New Container Terminal (NCT) and its overflow container yard in Chattogram.

The deal aims to modernize the terminal, increase operational efficiency, and enhance the overall capacity of the country's port and logistics infrastructure.

The agreement was discussed during a meeting between the Prime Minister and a delegation led by DP World's Chairman of the Board of Directors, Essa Kazim, at the secretariat on Thursday evening.

During the meeting, they also discussed expanding trade and investment between Bangladesh and the United Arab Emirates, as well as developments in the logistics sector.

The deal has faced opposition from some leftist groups and port labour organizations, who have announced mass hunger strikes to protest the agreement.

Police have already intervened to disperse protesters who erupted over the DP World deal to operate the NCT.

#Bangladesh #DPWorld #ChattogramPort #Logistics #Trade #Economy

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com, Prothom Alo
